import React from "react";
export default function Composer({state}){const [text,setText]=React.useState("");return <form onSubmit={event=>{event.preventDefault();if(state.canSend&&text.trim()&&window.chatter.sendMessage(text))setText("");}}><textarea aria-label="Message" value={text} onChange={event=>setText(event.target.value)}/>{state.sending?<button type="button" onClick={()=>window.chatter.stopGeneration()}>Stop</button>:<button disabled={!state.canSend||!text.trim()}>Send</button>}</form>;}
